title: L2: Live rounds 2-3 for all arms on dev-100 (bound ~7,000) -> STOP 2
description:
## Purpose

Complete the dev curves and freeze the arms.

## Scope

Rounds 2-3 (150 labels each), all arms on dev-100; freeze bundles; nothing chosen on the final slice.

## Request bound and cost cap

Bound ~7,000 Jev requests (use the printed bound). Cap: ~$7 worst case; cumulative must stay <= $10. Fresh ledger for this stage; gate needs `--max-new-requests` >= printed bound and <= ceiling; circuit breaker on; failures tallied by error class. Counts toward the hard cumulative cap of $10.

## Stop-point checks

**STOP 2** (owner looks): dev curves per arm and round; whether the feature cap fired every round.

## Definition of done

Dev curves table; frozen bundles; actual and cumulative spend.
